# Steady WASM function-attribution proposal

This checkpoint proposes exactly two future steady verification diagnostics, baseline then candidate, on the existing module bytes. No diagnostic adapter, WASM instance, profile, timing or build ran. The first node-visit bracket retained steady candidate means above 0.666666667 ms per 128 frames and demonstrated no consistent improvement; the candidate remains unselected.

`MODULE-NAMES.json` records read-only binary inspection. Each module has 21 function imports, 4,197 defined functions and 4,197 name entries. Their name maps agree. Only function index 3680 (`studioGainEnvelope.insertRange`) has different body bytes; both bodies occupy 1,141 encoded bytes. This establishes mapping and byte identity, without instruction-count or cost inference. The retained inspection source is indexed in the private source-v2 evidence; the initial Python compatibility failure remains in source-v1.

`PLAN.json` pins all existing source/module/runtime/evidence identities. It proposes an explicit diagnostic CPU-profile interval of 100 microseconds instead of the earlier 1,000, while retaining exact original verify work and the old profile/data/time caps. Actual sampling intervals and unresolved frames must be reported. The future parser must resolve actual WASM function indices from each exact module, report self/inclusive functions and caller paths, and distinguish preparation/runtime from graph samples. Function mapping establishes no source-line or instruction-level attribution, and inclusive counts overlap.

CPU profiling changes diagnostic argv and overhead. Its samples or elapsed times cannot be compared with the frozen timing bracket or establish speedup, callback/physical deadlines or headroom. No new Go arithmetic change follows from these source observations. A small indexed outer diagnostic host must first preserve the unchanged screen-child binding, fully owned setup/kill/reap lifecycle, closed I/O and raw verification identity. Source contracts and separate Chair release must precede either proposed child; no automatic retry, longer work, raised caps, profiler run or optimization edit is authorized here.
